headline: Confesercenti: "Energy costs are driving inflation, risk of +4% by year-end"
summary: Confesercenti's Rimini provincial director said energy costs are driving inflation and that the risk reaches +4% by year-end. He called for action on system charges and taxation.
why: Energy costs feed through to consumer prices and business margins, shaping inflation and central-bank policy expectations in Italy and the euro area.
